description.baseEffect:
Tier 9 · 1 Action · Concentration: Up to 1 minute.

1/turn, you can use 2 Actions to do one of the following:

  • Wraithvine | Arc: 8, Damage: 4d4+16. On hit: Slowed, 1 turn. On crit: you can place Huge or smaller targets anywhere in Range 8. You can choose to do no damage to individual targets.
  • Serene Grace | Burst: 2. Allies gain 4d4 temp HP, 1 round. If this would crit: Restore: HP equal to half the amount as well.

When you move, you can teleport from an adjacent plant to another that you can see. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before using it again.
